name: OSINT MCP Server
description: Exposes popular OSINT and reconnaissance tools like Sherlock, SpiderFoot, and Holehe through MCP and HTTP APIs for AI assistants. Runs security research tools in sandboxed environments and returns normalized JSON results for investigation and analysis.
